goal: Recover all 12 Syndicate seats and test SDX sovereignty/Zeus fit
body: Deep-recover the Syndicate Twelve from all shard stores and old Notion/Rhea exports. Current verified constraints: Hermes is one of the Twelve and Nyx's father; Hephaestus is a Twelve artisan running the Ember Veil foundry at Olympus Mons; APOLLO/Heliox is a narrative/media dynasty; OBSIDIAN is a data/platform dynasty; ARES is recovered as kinetic/ground enforcement; seats are dynastic and intermarry, including APOLLO↔OBSIDIAN bloodlines; older records describe a lord-of-the-underworld/Substrata ruler tier. Need the exact remaining seat names/functions, any Zeus record, and whether Zeus is one of Twelve, sovereign above Twelve, title, or location symbolism. Then reconcile with SDX/X99 ruling the Syndicate during Vol. 4 and with Nobunaga/Veil Throne continuity. Do not infer missing names.

relay.note: Partially resolved: 6 of 12 Syndicate seats confirmed (Ares, Apollo/Heliox, Obsidian, Hermes, Hephaestus, Zeus-as-candidate — shard:25729@db9). Zeus sovereign-vs-Twelve status and remaining 6 seat names still open per shard:27175@db4 (CANON_CANDIDATE, not locked). No names invented. Recommend next lane search dav1d_vault/rhea_noir_vault migrated shards (db8/db5) tagged migrated:veilverse for the unrecovered seats.
